10 minutes of AI help was enough to make people give up sooner on hard problems once the AI was gone

1,222 people in randomized trials (fractions, SAT reading). the AI group started more accurate, then dropped and skipped more when the tool was removed

if you build AI tools: hint before answer, let people do the last step

https://news.berkeley.edu/2026/10/09/using-ai-for-just-10-minutes-erodes-your-ability-to-persist-at-hard-things/
